response.text:
I can send it — quick confirmations before I proceed:

1) Which recipients exactly are in “the whole project list”? (mailing-list address or list of emails)  
2) Should I send the prepared status note as-is, or would you like to preview/edit it first?  
3) Any preferences for subject line, sender signature, or whether to put recipients in To vs BCC?  
4) Include any attachments?

Reply with the recipient address/list and “Send now” (or say “Preview” to review the draft first), and I’ll send it.
